objective: Test whether issuer-native PCB/product/application disclosures can provide a denominator-compatible revenue numerator without importing third-party industry shares or relabeling qualitative product presence as exposure magnitude.

issuer.name: Compeq Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
issuer.issuerNativeProductScope: One-stop PCB service provider; hard board, flexible board, rigid-flex board and SMT service; issuer material explicitly maps products to data-center and networking applications.

receipt.sourcePublishedAtBasis: Official Compeq investor-conference list shows a 2025-11-25 14:00 Uni-President Securities winter forum; the issuer-hosted PDF filename contains 20251121 but filename timestamp is not promoted to first-known publication time.

interpretation.validInference: Compeq disclosed that Data Center / Networking represented approximately 5% of 2025Q3 operation revenue under the issuer's own application taxonomy.
prohibitedInferences: Do not relabel the 5% as AI revenue.
Do not relabel the 5% as ABF-substrate revenue.
Do not transfer the 5% to Kinsus, Nan Ya PCB or any other issuer.
Do not infer product-level margin, customer exposure or stock-selection alpha from this mix.
Do not normalize the row from 101% to 100%; preserve issuer rounding.

positiveControlWhyItMatters: Unlike product-presence evidence, this receipt contains an issuer-native same-period revenue-share numerator and an explicit total-operation-revenue denominator, proving that compatible application exposure numerators are observable in Taiwan PCB issuers when companies choose to disclose them.

existingFirewall.nanYaPCB_8046: ABF/AI product-revenue numerator remains UNKNOWN unless a same-company denominator-compatible disclosure appears.
existingFirewall.kinsus_3189: ABF/AI product-revenue numerator remains UNKNOWN unless a same-company denominator-compatible disclosure appears.

maturityDecision.reason: A first compatible application-revenue numerator improves Taiwan data feasibility and the denominator contract, but it is one issuer/application observation, not ABF-specific exposure and not prospective/OOS predictive evidence.

exactNext: BR-059 add independent issuer-native product/application revenue numerators, prioritizing ABF/substrate-specific numerator evidence for 3189 and 8046 only when same-company same-period denominator compatibility is explicit; preserve broader Data Center / Networking as its own taxonomy and keep AI/ABF magnitude UNKNOWN otherwise; no composite structure score before OOS/redundancy tests.
